notes:
I wasn't able to write any of these notes. My first research call was blocked with a message saying I had no tool calls left for this turn, so I couldn't open any of the approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and to cite a URL for every point, so I haven't written anything from my own knowledge. A set of notes I couldn't source wouldn't meet your standard.

**What I'll do when tool access is back:**
1. **Verse-by-verse sources:** Enduring Word (enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ezekiel-46/), plus Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on BibleHub (biblehub.com/commentaries/[author]/ezekiel/46.htm), and Precept Austin.
2. **Differences between traditions:** Ezekiel's temple vision has a well-known split over whether its sacrifices (vv. 4–7, 13–15) are literal future offerings or symbolic. I'd check what Baptist, Reformed, Wesleyan, Pentecostal and Lutheran teachers say about that on their own sites (gty.org, ligonier.org, wesley.nnu.edu, samstorms.org, lcms.org), plus gotquestions.org and bible.org.
3. **Other views:** I'd check the NET Bible notes for modern scholarship. For Catholic and Orthodox readings I'd search newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org, in particular for how they treat the shut east gate (v. 1).

If you send the request again, or paste in the text of any pages you'd like used, I'll write the notes verse by verse with a URL for every point.
